fusions.name: Roadkill
fusions.desc: Rolls over the target with your full weight. The blow deals 34 damage that ignores resistance, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulk Through
fusions.desc: Shoulders your weight through everything in a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 16 damage and knocks each enemy back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Too Heavy to Stop
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Gathering Tonnage
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health settles over you for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
